title: Sasmita Mishal @ Samita Misal vs Apurba Andrapu .... Opposite Party on 11 April, 2025

paragraphs.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF ORISSA AT CUTTACK
 TRP(C) No.89 of 2025

 Sasmita Mishal @ Samita Misal .... Petitioner
 Mr. Soubhagya Kumar Dash, Advocate
 -versus-
 Apurba Andrapu .... Opposite Party

 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MURAHARI SRI RAMAN

Order No. ORDER
 01. 11.04.2025

 TRP(C) No.89 of 2025 & I.A.No.83 of 2025
This matter is taken up through Hybrid Mode.

2. This application has been filed by the learned counsel
 appearing for the Petitioner under Section 24 of the Code of Civil
 Procedure, 1908 for transfer of the C.P. No.5 of 2025, filed by the
 Opposite Party-husband under Section 32 of the Indian Divorce
 Act, 1869 for restitution of conjugal right pending before the Court
 of the learned Judge, Family Court, Paralakhemundi in the district
 of Gajapati to the Court of the learned Judge, Family Court,
 Rayagada.

3. Learned counsel appearing for the Petitioner submitted that
 the Petitioner-wife has filed Civil Proceeding No.6 of 2025 under
 Section 10(i)(ix) & (x) of the Indian Divorce Act, 1869 for
 dissolution of marriage by a decree of divorce at the instance of
 Opposite Party-husband before the Court of the learned Judge, Family
 Court, Rayagada. Therefore, the said C.P. No.5 of 2025 pending
 before the Court of the learned Judge, Family Court, Paralakhemundi


 Page 1 of 2
 in the district of Gajapati is required to be transferred to the Court of
 the learned Judge, Family Court, Rayagada for convenience.

4. Issue notice to the Opposite Party by Registered Post/Speed
 Post with A.D., requisites for which shall be filed within three
 working days. In the event of furnishing such requisite within the
 period stipulated, the Office shall send the notice to the Opposite Party
 by fixing a short returnable date.

6. As an interim measure, it is directed that further proceeding in
 C.P. No.5 of 2025, which is stated to be pending in the Court of the
 learned Judge, Family Court, Paralakhemundi in the district of
 Gajapati shall remain stayed till the next date.

(M.S. Raman)
 Judge
 Laxmikant
